messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-20260315-01 fired for service: rl-serving (canary). symptom=canary 502s + p99 latency spike on /v1/generate. pager: oncall@redwood -> eng-oncall assigned. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260315-01
Maria R.: saw the page, jumping in. any visibility on release tag?
Liam T.: deployed release 'lunar-aurora' to canary at 02:12 UTC, weight=20%. metrics dashboard (summary): error_rate 0.2% -> 5.9%, 502s concentrated on quantized inference nodes in us-west-2. p95 increased from 210ms -> 1.4s.
Ashley G.: confirmed. stack traces show prefill failures in kvcache path, example: `RuntimeError: kv cache prefill mismatch` (snippet below).
Ashley G.: ```
E 02:16:07 node-12 kernel: attempt to access freed buffer in quant_exec.cpp:line 412
Traceback (most recent frames): ...
```
Cheng W.: looks like the quant path change in lunar-aurora altered kernel selection for sequence lengths >1024. Canary load shows long tail. rolling back quant kernel flag might help.
SRE Lead: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce canary traffic to 0% 2) pin canary hosts to stable model variant 3) if that fails, rollback release across regions. assign roles.
Maria R.: assigning: Liam - telemetry + postmortem tracer, Ashley - run rollback commands, Cheng - config patch for kernel selector, SRE Lead - customer impact comms and PD escalation as needed.
Liam T.: collecting logs now. quick query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"rl-serving\",code=502}[2m])) by (instance)` shows spike on node-10..node-14. saving flamegraphs and attached link: https://telemetry.example/trace/abc123
pd-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-20260315-01 acknowledged by Maria R. at 02:18 UTC. escalation timer paused.
Maria R.: Ashley, can you run traffic diversion to stable? use infra tool: `routectl set-weight lunar-aurora 0 --canary` (dry run followed by apply).
Ashley G.: running now. dry run ok. applying: ```
$ routectl set-weight lunar-aurora 0 --canary --region=us-west-2
Applying traffic change... success. new weight=0%
kubectl rollout pause deployment/rl-serving -n prod
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rl-serving -n prod --to-revision=15
```
Ashley G.: rollback command executed; observing pods recreate.
Liam T.: after rollback, error rate dropped to 0.3% in the last 30s window. p99 falling back toward baseline.
Cheng W.: submitted small config revert for kernel selector (PR #4127) to avoid auto-selecting quant path for seq>1024 until we validate.
SRE Lead: customer impact: limited—affects ~12% of canary traffic (internal first-stage canaries) for short window. no customer-facing incidents observed in stable. drafting note for CS and status page.
Maria R.: pd-bot, please update incident with mitigation and mark as under control if metrics keep improving.
pd-bot: PagerDuty note added by Maria R.: Mitigated by rolling back 'lunar-aurora' canary (traffic -> 0%) and undoing deployment revision. monitoring for 15m.
eng-oncall: handing off to next shift in 30m for soak monitoring. next-oncall: @Cheng W. will own followups and the postmortem. please sync with SRE Lead for timeline.
Cheng W.: will own. collecting perf diffs and gating tests for kernel selection. adding an e2e that simulates long-prefill sequences.
Maria R.: thanks team. `:thumbsup:` leaving thread open for 20m then closing if stable.
SRE Lead: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (kernel selector + quant toggles), rollout safeguards (lower default canary weight & automated rollback threshold), add unit tests for kvcache prefill, and update runbook.
Maria R.: adding labels: incident-type=deploy-regression, severity=SEV3, cause=regression.
incident-bot: Incident closed? still monitoring.
Maria R.: closing in 12m if no regression. final note: no customer tickets so far; outreach paused.
